# Title

> Title constructor.

<!-- Section to include introductory text. Make sure to keep an empty line after the intro `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="intro">

A title configuration defines the text label placed along the edge of a chart. It supports a primary title and an optional subtitle, along with extensive styling options such as font, color, alignment, and orientation.

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var Title = require( '@stdlib/plot/vega/title/ctor' );
```

#### Title( \[options] )

Returns a title instance.

```javascript
var title = new Title();
// returns <Title>

title = new Title({
    'text': 'Monthly Revenue',
    'subtitle': 'Fiscal Year 2025',
    'anchor': 'middle',
    'fontSize': 18,
    'subtitleFontSize': 13,
    'subtitleColor': '#888'
});
// returns <Title>
```

<!-- <figure class="figure" align="center" label="fig:title" src="./docs/img/figure_title.svg" alt="A visualization showing a chart title with subtitle, font size, and color options."> -->

<div class="figure" align="center" data-figure="fig:title">
    <img src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/gururaj1512/stdlib@a7f3856b6b3b231de3f4c93c2b76f87be5bab78c/lib/node_modules/@stdlib/plot/vega/title/ctor/docs/img/figure_title.svg" alt="A visualization showing a chart title with subtitle, font size, and color options.">
    <br>
</div>

<!-- </figure> -->

The constructor accepts the following options:

-   **align**: horizontal text alignment of the title and subtitle.
-   **anchor**: anchor position for placing the title and subtitle. Default: `'middle'`.
-   **angle**: angle (in degrees) of the title and subtitle text.
-   **aria**: boolean indicating whether ARIA attributes should be included in SVG output. Default: `true`.
-   **baseline**: vertical baseline of the title and subtitle text.
-   **color**: color of the title text.
-   **dx**: horizontal offset (in pixels) added to the title and subtitle x-coordinate.
-   **dy**: vertical offset (in pixels) added to the title and subtitle y-coordinate.
-   **encode**: mark encodings for custom title styling.
-   **font**: font name of the title text.
-   **fontSize**: font size of the title text.
-   **fontStyle**: font style of the title text.
-   **fontWeight**: font weight of the title text.
-   **frame**: reference frame for the anchor position. Default: `'bounds'`.
-   **limit**: maximum allowed length (in pixels) of title and subtitle text.
-   **lineHeight**: line height for multi-line title text.
-   **offset**: orthogonal offset (in pixels) by which to displace the title from its position along the edge of the chart.
-   **orient**: title orientation. Default: `'top'`.
-   **subtitle**: subtitle text.
-   **subtitleColor**: color of the subtitle text.
-   **subtitleFont**: font name for the subtitle text.
-   **subtitleFontSize**: font size for the subtitle text.
-   **subtitleFontStyle**: font style for the subtitle text.
-   **subtitleFontWeight**: font weight for the subtitle text.
-   **subtitleLineHeight**: line height for multi-line subtitle text.
-   **subtitlePadding**: padding (in pixels) between title and subtitle text.
-   **text**: title text. Default: `[]`.
-   **zindex**: integer z-index indicating the layering of the title group relative to other axis, mark, and legend groups. Default: `0`.

* * *

### Writable Properties

<a name="prop-align"></a>

#### Title.prototype.align

Horizontal text alignment of the title and subtitle.

```javascript
var title = new Title({
    'text': 'Title Text',
    'subtitle': 'left title alignment',
    'subtitleFontStyle': 'italic',
    'subtitleFontSize': 12,
    'align': 'left',
    'fontSize': 16
});

var v = title.align;
// returns 'left'

title.align = 'center';

v = title.align;
// returns 'center'
```

<a name="prop-anchor"></a>

#### Title.prototype.anchor

Anchor position for placing the title and subtitle. Default: `'middle'`.

```javascript
var title = new Title({
    'text': 'anchor: start',
    'anchor': 'start',
    'fontSize': 16
});

var v = title.anchor;
// returns 'start'

title.anchor = 'middle';

v = title.anchor;
// returns 'middle'

title.anchor = 'end';

v = title.anchor;
// returns 'end'
```

<a name="prop-aria"></a>

#### Title.prototype.aria

Boolean indicating whether ARIA attributes should be included in SVG output. Default: `true`.

```javascript
var title = new Title();

var v = title.aria;
// returns true

title.aria = false;

v = title.aria;
// returns false
```

<a name="prop-encode"></a>

#### Title.prototype.encode

Mark encodings for custom title styling.

```javascript
var title = new Title();

var v = title.encode;
// returns undefined

title.encode = {
    'title': {
        'enter': {
            'fill': {
                'value': 'steelblue'
            }
        }
    }
};

v = title.encode;
// returns {...}
```

<a name="prop-font"></a>

#### Title.prototype.font

Font name of the title text.

```javascript
var title = new Title({
    'text': 'Serif Font Title',
    'font': 'serif',
    'fontSize': 16
});

var v = title.font;
// returns 'serif'

title.font = 'monospace';

v = title.font;
// returns 'monospace'
```

<a name="prop-limit"></a>

#### Title.prototype.limit

Maximum allowed length (in pixels) of title and subtitle text.

```javascript
var title = new Title({
    'text': 'A Very Long Title That Shows Without Limit',
    'fontSize': 16
});

var v = title.limit;
// returns undefined

title.limit = 200;

v = title.limit;
// returns 200
```

* * *

### Read-only Properties

<a name="prop-properties"></a>

#### Title.prototype.properties

List of enumerable properties.

```javascript
var title = new Title();

var v = title.properties;
// returns [ 'aria', 'align', 'anchor', 'angle', 'baseline', 'color', 'dx', 'dy', 'encode', 'font', 'fontSize', 'fontStyle', 'fontWeight', 'frame', 'limit', 'lineHeight', 'offset', 'orient', 'subtitle', 'subtitleColor', 'subtitleFont', 'subtitleFontSize', 'subtitleFontStyle', 'subtitleFontWeight', 'subtitleLineHeight', 'subtitlePadding', 'text', 'zindex' ]
```

* * *

### Methods

<a name="method-to-json"></a>

#### Title.prototype.toJSON()

Serializes a title instance to a JSON representation.

```javascript
var title = new Title({
    'text': 'Beep boop'
});

var v = title.toJSON();
// returns { 'aria': true, 'anchor': 'middle', 'frame': 'bounds', 'orient': 'top', 'text': [ 'Beep boop' ], 'zindex': 0 }
```

This method is implicitly invoked by `JSON.stringify`.

```javascript
var title = new Title({
    'text': 'Beep boop'
});

var v = JSON.stringify( title );
// returns '{"aria":true,"anchor":"middle","frame":"bounds","orient":"top","text":["Beep boop"],"zindex":0}'
```

* * *

### Events

#### 'change'

Emitted whenever a property value changes.

```javascript
var title = new Title();

title.on( 'change', onChange );

title.text = 'Beep boop';

function onChange( event ) {
    console.log( 'Updated property: %s', event.property );
}
```
